description.value:
Cost: 2 Sorcery Points

When you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can spend 2 Sorcery Points to change the casting time to a Bonus Action for this casting. You can't modify a spell in this way if you've already cast a level 1+ spell on the current turn, nor can you cast a level 1+ spell on this turn after modifying a spell in this way.

Automation (midi-qol entries): offered as you cast a spell (one Metamagic option per spell, Empowered and Seeking combine); its Sorcery Points come from Font of Magic. Careful Spell: the chosen creatures succeed on the save and take no damage from a spell doing half on a success.

entries.label: Quickened Spell
entries.groupLimit: bearer.items.some(i => i.identifier === 'sorcery-incarnate') && bearer.appliedEffects.some(e => e.name === bearer.items.find(i => i.identifier === 'innate-sorcery')?.name) ? 2 : 1
